name: Radiance Meshes
definition: A technique for representing radiance fields using constant density tetrahedral cells produced via Delaunay tetrahedralization. Each tetrahedron has constant density and linearly-varying color. It allows exact and fast volume rendering using rasterization and ray-tracing, solving the trade-off between optimization dynamics and rendering speed.
summary: Radiance Meshes represent radiance fields using constant density tetrahedral cells to enable exact, fast volume rendering via hardware rasterization, avoiding complex polyhedral tessellation or approximate sorting.
